faqs.q: What is Electric Chain Hoist, Type A used for?
faqs.a: Electric Chain Hoist, Type A is an electric chain hoist for repetitive lifting, rated 0.5 to 3 t. It is listed in 4 sizes, 0.5 t to 3 t.

faqs.q: How do I read an Indus part number for Electric Chain Hoist, Type A, such as IH-LR-EH-CA-0T5?
faqs.a: Electric Chain Hoist, Type A part numbers begin with IH-LR-EH-CA and end in a size code: IH-LR-EH-CA-0T5 is the 0.5 t size and IH-LR-EH-CA-3T is the 3 t size. Quote the full part number from the size table, or give us the size and the load you need, when you enquire.

faqs.q: What sizes does Electric Chain Hoist, Type A come in?
faqs.a: Electric Chain Hoist, Type A is listed in 4 sizes, 0.5 t to 3 t, each with its own Indus part number, for example IH-LR-EH-CA-0T5 and IH-LR-EH-CA-3T. The table includes 0.5 t: WLL 0.5 t, proof load 6.3 kN and 3 t: WLL 3 t, proof load 37.5 kN.

faqs.q: How do I choose the right size of Electric Chain Hoist, Type A?
faqs.a: For Electric Chain Hoist, Type A, choose on capacity, lift height, speed and duty, and state your supply voltage, phase and frequency on the RFQ.

faqs.q: What is the rated load of Electric Chain Hoist, Type A?
faqs.a: Electric Chain Hoist, Type A is listed with a working load limit 0.5 to 3 t. For example, 2 t: WLL 2 t, proof load 25 kN. The working load is the figure to lift or load to; proof and breaking loads are test figures and never working limits.

faqs.q: What material and finish is Electric Chain Hoist, Type A supplied in?
faqs.a: The listing for Electric Chain Hoist, Type A does not state the material or the finish. Tell us the environment it will work in and any material standard or coating you need, and we confirm what the maker can supply before you order.

faqs.q: What standard and certificate apply to Electric Chain Hoist, Type A?
faqs.a: For Electric Chain Hoist, Type A, the listing gives its documentation as: Manufacturer's test certificate. For third-party certification or a witnessed proof test, say so on the RFQ before the order is placed.

faqs.q: What does Electric Chain Hoist, Type A connect to or work with?
faqs.a: For Electric Chain Hoist, Type A, an electric hoist hangs from a fixed point or runs on a trolley along a beam, and the beam and supports must carry the hoist and its load. See the [beam trolleys shelf](/c/beam-trolleys) for trolleys and the [electric hoists shelf](/c/electric-hoists) for other models.

faqs.q: How should Electric Chain Hoist, Type A be inspected and looked after?
faqs.a: Before use, test the limit switches and the brake, check the chain or rope, the hooks and the control cable, and have Electric Chain Hoist, Type A examined periodically by a competent person. Report any unusual noise or slipping before the next lift.

faqs.q: How does Electric Chain Hoist, Type A differ from Electric Chain Hoist — Type B?
faqs.a: Electric Chain Hoist, Type A differs from [Electric Chain Hoist — Type B](/p/electric-chain-hoist-type-b) in its size range 0.5 t to 3 t against 0.25 t to 2 t; working load limit 0.5 to 3 t against 0.25 to 2 t.

Give us the part numbers, quantities and delivery country through our contact page and we quote the freight and lead time with the price.
